news.headline: 76ers' LeBron James, Joel Embiid sit against Hornets
news.description: LeBron James and Joel Embiid are out for the Sixers on Saturday in the second game of a back-to-back. It's the first time Philly is without both players at the same time.

news.headline: Sources: Thunder no longer signing Ochai Agbaji following Chet Holmgren injury
news.description: The Thunder are no longer signing free agent Ochai Agbaji as the franchise takes a step back to reevaluate its open roster spot after losing Chet Holmgren for two-plus months, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.

news.headline: Thunder's Chet Holmgren out 8-10 weeks; OKC flips on Agbaji signing, per sources
news.description: Chet Holmgren will be out eight to 10 weeks because of a knee injury, the latest setback for a Thunder team that lost Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace for an extended time early this week.

news.headline: Without injured Brown, 76ers outlast Knicks in NBA Cup Group Play
news.description: Philadelphia forward Jaylen Brown missed Friday night's NBA Cup game against the New York Knicks because of a left patella injury, the 76ers announced shortly before their 98-93 victory at the Xfinity Mobile Arena.

news.headline: Ja Morant out at least 4 weeks with hamstring strain suffered against Grizzlies
news.description: Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant sustained a left hamstring strain in his first game against the Grizzlies, his former team, and will be out for at least four weeks.

news.headline: Sources: Thunder signing Agbaji to fill roster after Williams, Wallace injuries
news.description: The Thunder are signing forward Ochai Agbaji to fill their open roster spot in the wake of major injuries suffered to starting wings Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.
